defects.claim_says: Other later orders that amend EO 10900 (EO 10972, EO 11036, EO 11963, EO 12148) concern other sections: ... a new subsection of section 1 ... (EO 10972, 11036, 11963, 12148 (amendments of other sections of EO 10900))
defects.source_says: EO 11963 (January 19, 1977, 42 FR 4325) section 2: 'Executive Order No. 10900, as amended, is further amended by revoking Section 5 thereof and redesignating Sections 6, 7 and 8 as Sections 5, 6 and 7 respectively.' Section 6 at that date was the Director of the Food-for-Peace Program section inserted by EO 10915 section 1 (original section 5 of EO 10900 was the reservation of reporting functions), so EO 11963 renumbered this very clause as section 5

EO 11963 section 2 redesignated the inserted section 6 as section 5 on 1977-01-19; this change to the tracked clause should be recorded as a later event (it is not an end; the clause survived as section 5 until EO 12220 section 1-501)

reasoning: With the dates restored, the end dates themselves are right: sections 2 and 111 end 1961-09-30 by EO 10973 section 605(b) (named supersession of section 2 of EO 10915; section 111 sat in Part I of EO 10893, superseded by 605(a)), with section 607's retroactive effective date and signing on 1961-11-03 disclosed. The lead clause (section 6 of EO 10900) ends 1980-06-27 when EO 12220 section 1-501 revokes EO 10900 as amended. The EO 11252 transfer is correctly a later event: it modifies the order and does not end it. The whole-order end equals the latest clause end. Savings via EO 10973 section 606 are accurately described. However, the claim's account of the clause's later history is wrong for EO 11963. The claim says EO 11963 only adds a new subsection to section 1 and belongs among amendments to 'other sections'. In fact EO 11963 section 2 revoked section 5 of EO 10900 and redesignated the EO 10915-inserted section 6 as section 5. That is a change to the tracked clause itself, so it should be recorded as a later event. It is not an end, and the 1980 end date is unaffected. A factual misstatement in judgment_reason and research_rationale, plus an omitted later event, fails the standard applied to every other claim, so the claim is rejected. The fix is to add EO 11963 (1977-01-19, redesignation) as a later event and correct the sentence.
